replacement: description: "Use when the task requires automating a real browser from the terminal (navigation, form filling, snapshots, screenshots, data extraction, UI-flow debugging) via `npx @playwright/cli` in PowerShell."
Drive a real browser through the DSH `pwsh` tool using `npx @playwright/cli`. This runs the CLI without requiring a global installation or a bash wrapper.
Before proposing commands, check whether `npx` is available:

```powershell
Get-Command npx -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
```powershell
Once `npx` is present, run the CLI directly. A global install of `playwright-cli` is optional.
## DSH execution environment

Use PowerShell commands through `pwsh`. The installed Skill is at `{{HARNESS_HOME}}/skills/playwright`; commands below call the npm package directly and do not use the retained `.sh` resource. Before using a browser that needs an existing login session, check whether the available CLI can connect to that session. The DSH tool list does not provide a `playwright-chrome` connector.
Run the package directly:

```powershell
npx @playwright/cli open https://playwright.dev --headed
npx @playwright/cli snapshot
npx @playwright/cli click e15
npx @playwright/cli type "Playwright"
npx @playwright/cli press Enter
npx @playwright/cli screenshot
```powershell

```powershell
npx @playwright/cli --help

用户在 DSH 聊天中下指令，由代理负责准备、启动和更新面板；每个新任务不要求用户手动启动其他软件。面板是本机页面，显示同目录 `state.json` 的内容。它只能呈现代理写入的进度，不能自行推断工具进度。按当前宿主可用的展示位置呈现；没有右侧浏览器时，按 Skill 正文使用聊天和文档保持当前入口。

4. 在最终回复中给出返回的 URL，并使用可用浏览器检查面板是否读取到状态。此面板通过 HTTP 读取 `state.json`，持续查看使用该 URL。`present` 接受文件路径，不接受 URL，也不创建宿主侧栏；可用它交付路线记录文档，面板 HTML 与 JSON 保留为维护来源。当前宿主提供其他持续展示入口时按其协议接入；今后本任务的内容更新只改 JSON，不要求用户刷新页面。服务或 DSH 退出后，由代理按同一步骤重开。
